PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.DragonBreath: The creature unleashes its elemental power as a mighty breath weapon. Creatures in the area attempt a basic saving throw.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.WingBuffet.D: The creature beats its wings and throws nearby foes off balance.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.LifeDrain.De: The creature siphons life from a struck foe and weakens its body.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.DeathlessRec: Unnatural power lets the creature shrug off a devastating blow or rise once more.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.EmergencyRep: The creature realigns damaged mechanisms and stabilizes its body.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.UnstableDisc: The creature vents excess energy into the surrounding area and briefly dazzles affected foes.

PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Effect.Drained1.Desc: The creature gains the drained 1 condition.

PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.HydraHeads.D: Several independently acting heads let the creature threaten and react at once. The number of heads and reactions scales with level. Severed heads may regrow at the GM’s discretion.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.PhoenixRebir: The first time the creature dies, it can return from its own embers after a short delay. Rebirth unleashes a burst of fire; resurrection and save outcomes are intentionally adjudicated by the GM.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Ability.ElementalRet: When pressed, the creature’s elemental core discharges into its surroundings. Damage type and trait follow its elemental affinity.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.TrollRegen: The creature’s regeneration. Acid or fire damage deactivates it according to the PF2e regeneration effect.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.VampiricDr: The creature gains temporary Hit Points from stolen vitality.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.PhoenixReb: Direct fire damage from the rebirth flame. The GM adjudicates the basic save and resurrection.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Signature.ElementalR: Direct damage from elemental retaliation. The GM adjudicates the basic save.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Title: Mythic
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Role.Label: Mythic role
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Role.Hint: Automatic maps the normal creature role to a mythic role template.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Ambus: Uses the extreme skill value for Stealth.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Hazar: Does not trigger hazard reactions in its own lair and ignores damaging area effects created by those hazards.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Bruti: Uses the extreme skill value for Athletics.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Feroc: Cost 1 Mythic Point. When reduced to 0 HP, remain conscious at half maximum HP and increase wounded by 1. This cannot be used at wounded 3.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Titan: Ignores size limitations for actions such as Grapple or Trip.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Devas: Uses the high spell DC and spell attack modifier for its level, or extreme values from level 11 onward.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Mythi: Uses the extreme skill value for the skill associated with its magical tradition.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Deadl: After moving at least 10 feet with Stride, Burrow, Climb, or Fly, the next Strike deals 1d6 additional precision damage.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Mobil: Uses the extreme skill value for Acrobatics.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Resil: The listed saving throws are treated as one degree of success better than rolled.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Resis: Resistance against Strikes made by non-mythic creatures. Mythic weapons bypass it.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Defen: An attacker that rolls a critical hit must reroll the attack and use the new result.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Ability.Immun: Immunity to the selected category of non-mythic attacks or spells.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.MythicS: Cost 1 Mythic Point. The next selected skill check gains +4 and uses mythic proficiency.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.RemoveC: Cost 1 Mythic Point. End one condition currently affecting the creature.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.Recharg: Cost 1 Mythic Point. Gain another use of a spell or ability that normally has limited uses.
Cost 1 Mythic Point. Regain a spent spell use.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.Undying: Spend all remaining Mythic Points when the creature would die. It remains conscious and regains 50% of its maximum HP.
Cost 1 Mythic Point after failing a check. Reroll the check and use the new result.
PF2E_CREATURE_FORGE.Mythic.Power.Unimped: Cost 1 Mythic Point. End a circumstance penalty to Speed; Escape automatically succeeds against immobilized, grabbed, or restrained.
